test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ranjumoni Saikia won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award of 2019 for which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattiya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ranjumoni Saikia:-**

 
 
• She won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award of 2019 for the dance form called Sattriya. 
 
 
 
• **Sattriya:-**
 
 
• It is a classical dance form that originated in the state of Assam, India.
 
• It is one of the eight recognized classical dance forms of India.
 
• Sattriya is a devotional dance form that is performed in the monasteries of Assam, known as sattras.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi:-**

 
 
• It is a classical dance form that originated in the state of Odisha, India. It is characterized by fluid movements and facial expressions that depict stories from Hindu mythology.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam:-**
 
 
• It is a classical dance form that originated in the state of Tamil Nadu, India. It is characterized by intricate footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions that convey stories from Hindu mythology.
 
 
 
• **Chhau:-**
 
 
• it is a classical dance form that originated in the eastern states of India, namely Jharkhand, Odisha, and West Bengal. It is characterized by masked dancers who depict stories from Hindu mythology.
